items.title: Widerspruch gegen den Anerkennungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post by a social-law body (Unfallkasse, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). Deemed delivery = 4th day after posting (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, PostModG), counting calendar days from 20.11.2026: 21.11 (Sat, day1), 22.11 (Sun, day2), 23.11 (Mon, day3), 24.11 (Tue, day4) → deemed delivered 24.11.2026. Social-law bodies (SGB X) do not shift the delivery day even onto a weekend, so it stays 24.11.2026 (in this case a Tuesday anyway, so moot). One-month Widerspruch period under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 84 SGG): day of delivery (24.11.) not counted, period ends on the day with the same number one month later = 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is explicitly a working day under German deadline rules, and it is not a nationwide or NRW public holiday, so the period ends on 24.12.2026 without further shift.
